ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What nucleic acid carries the genetic information in the cell and is capable of self-replication and synthesis of RNA?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram has an obvious blue-green double helix structure, with colorful base-pair rungs inside; the right side also shows the form in which this double helix further coils, compresses, and is packaged in a structure similar to a cell nucleus/cell. Reasoning: The question asks which nucleic acid carries genetic information in cells, and can self-replicate and guide RNA synthesis. In biology, deoxyribonucleic acid undertakes these functions; it is both the main carrier of cellular genetic information, can replicate, and serves as the template for transcription to synthesize RNA. Therefore the answer is DNA.
